neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * We’ve launched the [Usage and Cost Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api) in beta with the `analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24` beta header. Its `/v1/organizations/analytics/usage` and `/v1/organizations/analytics/cost` endpoints report token usage and cost for Claude Console and Claude Enterprise organizations. You can filter and group results by dimensions such as model, workspace, API key, and the user or service account behind each request.

* The [Usage and Cost API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-api) is now a legacy API, and so are the `usage_report`, `cost_report`, `user_usage_report`, and `user_cost_report` endpoints of the [Claude Enterprise Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api). All of them remain supported. To move an existing integration, see [Migrate from the Usage and Cost API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api#migrate-from-usage-cost-api) or [Migrate from the Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api#migrate-from-enterprise-analytics-reports).

neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * We’ve raised the [maximum request size](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview#request-size-limits) for the Messages API and the Token Counting API from 32 MB to 128 MB on the first-party Claude API.
